en.name: Ham, uncured and uncooked
en.summary: An uncured, uncooked ham is a raw pork leg that has never seen curing salt or smoke — the butcher's name for it is fresh ham, and it behaves like any large raw pork roast. It keeps 3–5 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and 6 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: There is no room-temperature storage for raw pork. Nothing in an uncured ham inhibits bacterial growth, so once it is in the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) the clock runs: two hours out of the cold, one hour if the room is above 32 °C (90 °F). A large joint takes a long time to chill down again, so get it into the fridge quickly rather than letting it sit while you clear space.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on the lowest shelf and on a tray big enough to catch any drip, and cook it within 3–5 days of purchase. Nothing ready to eat should sit below or beside it. Leave it in the butcher's wrapping until you are ready, and if you are brining or marinating the joint do it in the fridge in a covered container, not on the counter. Cook it through and rest it before carving.
en.freezer: A whole raw fresh ham keeps 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality — longer than the cooked version, because raw muscle in one solid piece has far less cut surface exposed to the freezer than sliced roast meat does. Wrap it in film then heavy foil or a freezer bag, pressing out the air, and label it with the date. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the six months are about quality.
en.thawing: Thaw a whole ham in the fridge, allowing roughly a day for every 2 kg, on a tray on the bottom shelf. Cold running water in a sealed bag works for smaller cuts and needs immediate cooking. Never thaw on the counter, and never refreeze raw pork that has fully thawed at room temperature.
spoilage: A sour, sulphurous or distinctly off smell once the wrapping is opened.
A slimy or sticky surface rather than a moist, firm one.
Grey, green or iridescent patches through the meat.
Purge liquid in the pack gone cloudy, thick or ropy.
tips: Ask the butcher to cut a big leg into two or three roasts so you can freeze what you will not use.
Freeze on the day of purchase if the whole joint will not be cooked within a few days.
Brine or marinate in the fridge, in a covered container, never on the counter.
Wash hands, board and knife straight after handling; raw pork juices travel further than people expect.

faq.q: How long does a raw fresh ham keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–5 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on the bottom shelf and on a tray.

faq.q: Can you freeze a raw fresh ham?
faq.a: Yes, 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Wrap it in film and then foil or a freezer bag.

faq.q: How do you thaw a whole raw ham safely?
faq.a: In the fridge, roughly a day per 2 kg, on a tray on the bottom shelf. Never on the counter.

zh.name: 未醃漬生火腿
zh.summary: 未醃漬、未熟製的火腿，其實就是一支從沒碰過醃漬鹽和煙燻的生豬後腿；肉舖叫它「新鮮火腿」，性質和任何一大塊生豬腿肉一樣。冷藏 4 °C 以下 3～5 天，冷凍 −18 °C 下 6 個月。
zh.pantry: 生豬肉沒有常溫保存這件事。未醃漬的腿肉裡沒有任何東西在抑制細菌，只要落在 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶，時間就開始跑：離開冷藏 2 小時，室溫超過 32 °C 時 1 小時。大塊肉要重新降溫很費時，所以請先騰位置，拿回來就立刻進冰箱。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下、冰箱最下層，底下墊一個接得住血水的托盤，購買後 3～5 天內烹調。旁邊和下方都不要放即食食品。要用之前就維持肉舖的原包裝；要泡鹽水或醃漬，請放在加蓋容器裡於冰箱中進行，不要放在流理台上。要煮透，切之前先靜置。
zh.freezer: 整塊生的新鮮火腿在 −18 °C 下品質可維持 6 個月，比熟製版本更久——因為一整塊完整的生肌肉，暴露在冷凍空氣中的切面遠少於切片的烤肉。先用保鮮膜包、再包厚鋁箔或裝冷凍袋，壓出空氣並標上日期。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，這六個月講的是品質。
zh.thawing: 整塊請放冷藏解凍，大約每 2 公斤預留一天，墊托盤放最下層。較小的肉塊可以密封裝袋用冷水沖，沖完要立刻烹調。不要放室溫退冰；已在室溫下完全退冰的生豬肉也不要再冷凍。
spoilage: 拆開包裝聞到酸味、硫磺味或明顯異味。
表面發黏、黏手，而不是濕潤結實。
肉裡出現灰色、綠色或虹彩般的斑塊。
包裝滲出的血水變混濁、變稠或牽絲。
tips: 請肉舖把整支腿分切成兩三塊，用不到的直接冷凍。
如果幾天內煮不完整塊，買回來當天就冷凍。
鹽水或醃料都在冰箱裡加蓋進行，絕不要放流理台。
處理完立刻洗手、洗砧板和刀；生豬肉的血水跑得比你想像的遠。

faq.q: 生的新鮮火腿冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下 3～5 天，放最下層並墊托盤。

faq.q: 生的新鮮火腿可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下 6 個月品質最好。先包保鮮膜再包鋁箔或裝冷凍袋。

faq.q: 整塊生火腿要怎麼安全解凍？
faq.a: 放冷藏解凍，大約每 2 公斤一天，墊托盤放最下層。不要放室溫。
